a.lede: A nuclear detonation in space "could cause rapid and sudden loss or degradation of thousands of satellites."
a.title: Reports: Russia may launch nuclear weapon into orbit as soon as next month

b.lede: Intelligence agencies believe that Russia has spent the last several years readying Sputnik-S, a satellite armed with a nuclear weapon that could be used to destroy rival satellites in Earth's orbit — and it's expected to launch before the end of 2026.
b.title: Russia readying nuclear-armed satellite that could destroy every low-Earth-orbit satellite, report claims
